name: Convenience: Flight Master's Whistle retreats to a real flight master from Goldshire (#6636)
contract: Flight Master's Whistle (item 10, spell 158) promises 'Call in a ride and Retreat to one of the nearest
Flightmasters!'. Reported from Goldshire (map 0, -9561.2 9.5 59.1), where the nearest taxi-node entries are
Ascension's own 'Filming' (168) and 'Goldshire, Elwynn Forest' (407), but no flight master creature stands within
reach of either node: the only flight masters in Elwynn Forest are Dungar Longdrink (352) at the Stormwind node
(-8835.8, 490.1, 109.7) and Thor (523) at Sentinel Hill. Retreating must land the player where a flight master
actually stands, so the whistle used in Goldshire arrives at the Stormwind flight master instead of leaving the
player standing in Goldshire. Node positions come from the client's TaxiNodes.dbc; the flight master creatures
come from the world database of the tested build.

steps.label: The player starts where the report was filed
The whistle lands at the Stormwind flight master
The landing spot is the flight master's own ground
